header: A package price against the sum of its parts
lead: The saving is the whole argument, so the band shows the working: every item keeps its own figure and the comparison total is labelled in words.
note: The note carries the conditions — how often the bundle can be taken, when it is payable, whether tax is included.

contents.title: Each item keeps its own price
contents.text: A saving nobody can check is a claim rather than an argument.

contents.title: The comparison figure is named, not just struck
contents.text: A line through a number says withdrawn; it does not say what the number was.

contents.title: The item prices sit in one column
contents.text: So a reader can run down them and reach the total themselves.
